story.iWant: to have clear usage instructions and troubleshooting guidance
story.soThat: I can quickly resolve issues and have a good experience when using the one-click launcher
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Comprehensive User Documentation (AC: 1, 8) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Write detailed README.md with step-by-step installation guide - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Create system requirements and compatibility matrix - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Add FAQ section covering common user questions - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Document configuration options and customization capabilities - [ ] Subtask 1.5: Create quick start guide for non-technical users
- [ ] Task 2: Troubleshooting and Support Resources (AC: 2) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Create comprehensive troubleshooting guide - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Document common error messages and solutions - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Create diagnostic tools for user self-help - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Provide contact information for technical support - [ ] Subtask 2.5: Create log analysis and export tools for support
- [ ] Task 3: Cross-Platform Installation Scripts (AC: 3) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Create install.bat for Windows with UAC handling - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Create install.sh for Unix systems (macOS/Linux) - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Add dependency checking and automatic installation - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Implement progress indicators and user guidance - [ ] Subtask 3.5: Add silent installation options for advanced users
- [ ] Task 4: Desktop Integration and Accessibility (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Implement desktop shortcut creation functionality - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Create Start Menu entries (Windows) - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Add Dock integration (macOS) - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Implement auto-start configuration options - [ ] Subtask 4.5: Create uninstall scripts and cleanup procedures
- [ ] Task 5: User Feedback and Error Reporting (AC: 5, 7) - [ ] Subtask 5.1: Implement user-friendly error message system - [ ] Subtask 5.2: Create automated error reporting and diagnostic collection - [ ] Subtask 5.3: Add multi-language support for user interface - [ ] Subtask 5.4: Create user feedback submission system - [ ] Subtask 5.5: Implement telemetry for usage analytics (optional)
- [ ] Task 6: Visual and Interactive Guides (AC: 6) - [ ] Subtask 6.1: Create video tutorial or animated GIF guide - [ ] Subtask 6.2: Implement interactive first-run wizard - [ ] Subtask 6.3: Add tooltips and contextual help in launcher - [ ] Subtask 6.4: Create guided tour for main features - [ ] Subtask 6.5: Implement progressive disclosure of advanced options
- [ ] Task 7: Performance and Usability Optimization (AC: 8) - [ ] Subtask 7.1: Optimize startup time and resource usage - [ ] Subtask 7.2: Add performance monitoring and optimization tips - [ ] Subtask 7.3: Implement caching mechanisms for faster subsequent starts - [ ] Subtask 7.4: Create system recommendations and upgrade guidance - [ ] Subtask 7.5: Add benchmarking and comparison tools

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Comprehensive README.md with detailed installation and usage instructions 2. Troubleshooting guide covering common issues and solutions 3. One-click installation scripts (install.bat for Windows, install.sh for macOS/Linux) 4. Desktop shortcut creation functionality for easy future access 5. Complete user feedback and error reporting mechanisms 6. Video tutorial or quick start guide for non-technical users 7. Multi-language support for error messages (Chinese/English) 8. Performance optimization tips and system requirements documentation

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: 用户体验目标: 让非技术用户在1分钟内成功启动完整的量化交易平台，无需配置开发环境

doc.title: Technical Architecture
doc.snippet: 采用纯Python + CLI的跨平台部署自动化架构，实现90%以上常见环境问题的自动解决能力

doc.title: Epic Specifications
doc.snippet: 专注于解决部署痛点的最后一公里，通过智能化的启动脚本封装技术复杂性

codefile.reason: Primary launcher entry point with CLI interface
Contains Chinese character display handling and UTF-8 setup
Complete backend dependency list including FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Redis, pandas
Frontend Node.js dependencies with Next.js 14, React 18, Chart.js
OS detection functionality for cross-platform support
Service orchestration and startup sequence management
Rich progress bars and user feedback display

dependency.packages: fastapi==0.111.0, uvicorn==0.29.0, sqlalchemy==2.0.30, redis==5.0.4, pandas==2.2.2, pydantic==2.7.3

constraints.constraint: Must support Windows 10/11, macOS, and Linux distributions
Non-technical users should complete setup within 5 minutes
90% of common environment issues must be auto-resolvable
Support for Chinese/English error messages and documentation
Create desktop shortcuts and start menu entries
Cross-platform install.bat for Windows and install.sh for Unix systems

tests.standards: Test using pytest for Python components, Jest for frontend integration, and end-to-end testing with Playwright. All installation scripts must be tested on target platforms. Documentation must be validated for technical accuracy and user comprehensibility.

test.idea: Installation script validation on macOS and Linux
